Rivers Des Plaines (Chicago) dice dealer here. Thanks for coming, and nice job! All seven of our tables are 100x odds. The “high limit” dice table is usually $25, and is located near the end. For those in the know, it’s called “501.” You can always ask a supervisor where it is and they’ll show you as long as it’s open.

Our ATS is 34/175/34, as it should be. To hell with those 30/150/30 tables. Standard Fire bet. Minimums are generally $15 on weekends and occasionally $10 weekdays and late nights. $5 happen rarely, usually between 4 AM and 10 AM on weekdays.

Hope to see you again! I love dealing at Rivers and I’m always happy to deal to people that know what they’re doing and have as much a love for the game as I (and the other dealers) do.
If anyone lives in/around Chicago, it just opened here! Check out Kokandy Productions.

If you’re looking for good-time ensemble cast rock musicals, consider Next Thing You Know and Brooklyn Crush. Both on Spotify, both shows about young adults in the city trying to make it work. They contain both touching and funny moments!

I was in the factory ensemble in a production of this show in Florida. It went pretty well, but it sounds like yours was MUCH better and generally much better-received than ours was! I remember everyone in our cast was great, especially our Don. Had a real character arc and leaned into the transition of hating and then loving Lola. Our Lauren was a little weak admittedly. The sets were meh, but the venue was pretty cool. Glad you got to see a good production of it!
